name: Window Stack
tagline: Cream desktop-notes page: a hand-circled count hook, an ink folder spilling window cards, three captioned app windows per slide.
whenToUse: 'I read / ran / tested N' findings listicles (declared Spine C variant: 3 numbered windows per stack slide, at most 3 stack slides)
Tools, repos and skills one per slide in a proof window; prompts and configs in a terminal window

fonts.regular: Inter 400 — captions, byline role (Inter 700 for the byline name)
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono 400 — counter, item numbers, item range, window labels, terminal body

palette.window: title bar + frame #E9E2D8, body #FFFFFF, hard shadow #B3A99E +10/+10, dots #EE4B3F / #F5A524 / #2DB84B
palette.accent: #D9551F — arrow, ellipse, strike, one accent number or word per slide only

windows.stack: 840 x 252 at y 200 / 556 / 912, captions 24 px under the shadow
windows.proof/terminal: 840 x 742 at y 200, captions from y 976

fitPass.headline: 48 px one line beside the item range, floor 45
fitPass.captions: 34 px one line in 840 px (34 is the floor), <= 46 chars
fitPass.hook: auto-fit so the widest line is 840 px, max 128, floor 64
fitPass.terminal: 28 px, shrinks to 22 to fit the body
fitPass.copyLimits: headline and tip lines <= 7 words, window tips <= 6 words, captions <= 46 chars, <= 3 windows per stack, <= 3 stack slides
fitPass.onFailure: a red FIT/COPY banner across the top of the slide (visible in the export on purpose) + console.error + window.fitReport

files.slides.html: copy to carousel root, edit DECK + slides[] at bottom
files.preview.png: cover + stack slide rendered from this file's sample slides
